U3-err-matter.holds_other_matter.en: Clauseo won't work in this matter while another matter's folder is inside its folder. Your question is kept.
U3-err-matter.holds_other_matter.hi: जब तक किसी दूसरे मामले का फ़ोल्डर इस मामले के फ़ोल्डर के अंदर है, Clauseo इस मामले में काम नहीं करेगा। आपका प्रश्न रखा गया है।
U3-err-matter.holds_other_matter.note: matter.holds_other_matter: the turn's stop line when another matter on Clauseo's list lies inside this matter's folder (folders moved outside Clauseo); at a launch, a resume or before a prompt. The question is kept; the UC-387 notice before it names the matter

UC-387.en: {matter}'s folder is inside this matter's folder. Move it out, or remove {matter} from the list. If you remove it, its papers count as part of this matter.
UC-387.hi: {matter} का फ़ोल्डर इस मामले के फ़ोल्डर के अंदर है। उसे बाहर ले जाएँ, या {matter} को सूची से हटा दें। अगर आप उसे हटाते हैं, तो उसके दस्तावेज़ इस मामले का हिस्सा माने जाएँगे।
UC-387.note: CHANGED LINE (wording page): was "{matter} is inside this matter's folder. Move {matter}'s folder out of it, or remove one of the two matters from Clauseo."; the app thread's final words: removing the outer matter is no longer offered, and a removed inner matter's papers count as the outer's. Host notice NoticeKind::MatterInside, given with each turn refused matter.holds_other_matter; {matter} is the inner matter by its name now, bidi-isolated

UC-485.en: Its folder is inside {outer}'s folder, so conversations in {outer} will be able to read its papers.
UC-485.note: Added line in the Remove from the list confirm (UC-131, UC-132) when the host's MatterSummary.inside names the listed matter whose folder holds this one's; {outer} is that matter's name now, bidi-isolated
